newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats EPS raised.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Michael Mauboussin said Thursday he raised his pro forma earnings estimate for Quaker Oats Co to $1.75 a share from $1.70, based on continuing operations excluding the company's Snapple beverage business.
-- Quaker has agreed to sell Snapple and is expected to take a first quarter charge of about $8.40 a share for the sale of that business.
-- Earlier, Quaker said it expects first quarter operating earnings to be above the current consensus of $0.18 a share and at least equal to last year's earnings of $0.22 a share.
-- "The company had been guiding people a little more optimistically," Mauboussin said of Quaker's earnings projection. "While this is a pleasant surprise, it's not a complete shock."
-- Quaker Oats shares were down 1/8 at 38-1/2.
